sources.section: Scope cards O06/O11; cross-industry service catalog; common terms
First-project setup correction; Ben-workbook correction; objections and no-sale conditions

economics: Modeled research fees are not buyer budgets, quotes, validated market value or ROI.
Include unsuccessful acquisition, full first-project setup unless reusable work already exists, learning, revisions, support, travel, fees and cash costs.
Do not amortize setup over customers who do not exist. Ben assistance is hypothetical unless explicitly agreed; audited correction governs assistance calculations.
exclusions: No automatic canonical Offer ID mapping or pricing.
No current platform-capability claim without current authoritative evidence.
No invented competence, demand, conversion or ranking lift.
cards.title: Sign/print: quote-ready intake versus existing-provider resolution
method: Ask the estimator to demonstrate repeated missing specifications or artwork-handoff friction.
Compare exact native workflow, plan, permissions, staff use and provider help before proposing another form.
Practice a bounded workflow and acceptance cases on the actual supported tools before committing.
alternatives: No sale if estimator capacity or an adequate current process is the real constraint
invalidators: Unsupported file handling, production responsibility or missing delivery competence

cards.title: B2B cleaning: buyer presentation versus capacity/procurement
method: Distinguish an observed inquiry-path problem from owner-confirmed capability presentation, staffing or procurement constraints.
A narrow contact repair and a five-page capability site are different scopes; do not turn one into the other.
Confirm desired customer type, walkthrough process, provider coverage, supplied content and capacity before selecting an intervention.
alternatives: Narrow contact-path repair if independently worthwhile
No demand project when capacity is constrained and no worthwhile operational need is established
invalidators: No approved business facts, authority, scope or supported delivery route

cards.title: Warm editing: task, access, training and platform alternatives
cards.scope_reference: Method applied to a hypothetical request
method: Define the exact blocked editing task, observed outcome and desired independent workflow.
Verify account control, permissions and existing-provider responsibilities; do not infer platform limitations from the complaint.
Compare permissions/training and provider assistance before investigating a possible platform move.
A move requires separately verified target capability, asset/email/integration preservation, recovery, competence and explicit authority.
alternatives: Partner or decline if responsibility exceeds supported competence
invalidators: No exact task or authorized access
No verified target capability or recovery plan
A hypothetical request is not a confirmed customer or migration approval
